item.title: Tmux Setup
item.description: How I use tmux Tmux is a terminal multiplexer: it lets you open multiple panes, windows, and sessions seamlessly. I started using it for a neatly organized terminal setup and am perfecting its use while trying to solve CTF challenges. Being efficient in moving from one terminal window to the other is essential for ease of mind. Additionally, exploiting tmux splitting panes functions with pwntools script, I think, can give you a competitive edge when debugging exploits.
